book.name: 1 CORINTO
book.title: 1 CORINTO Corinto janinhahbo qui Pablonen raanni joi

content: Joni huetsahon shinanaxma bi jonibo jai quescarax yohuanax cah hen cororesan. Joni huetsahon shinanyamahax bi Papan yonotibo jai quescari yohuanah cah hen corotihcamahan. Jihui behman rishquihah peenhahcacamahi.
Jayaxihquibo yohiti honan jaxon, jatihibi jone joi rihbi honanxon, jatihibi honan rihbi jaxon, mahchibo potahahtanti hahtipahnoxon caman shinanxon bi joni huetsahon shinanyamahax cah hen jahuamascan.
Hena jatihibi hinanresax, heen yora rihbi mapojahabo hen hinamehxon bi joni huetsahon shinanyamaxon cah hen jahuabi bihyamahan.

Joni huetsahon shinanxon tah non jatsanti tenetihi. Joni huetsahon shinanxon cah non jato hahxonan. Notsi notsiyamarihbitihi. Caibo mahuinax jaya joihi nihyamahi. Joni huetsahon shinanxon cah non yohiresyamahan; nincarihbihan.
Joni huetsahon shinanxon cah non jato sirijaquin yohuanquihntihi. Noquenahbi res benayamarihbiquin. Histon rainyamayamahi. Copiti shinanyamarihbiquin.
Joni huetsahon shinanax cah non hahqui jatsanyamahi. Jaan ta jahuentianbi shinanquin sirijatimahiqui hihyamahi. Sirija ta jatihiqui hihqui. Jascaxon teneresquin, jatihibi noquen huetsabo tenequin.

Joni huetsahon shinanxon hahxonti shinanbo ta queyoyosmabo shinanbo qui. Caibo shinanbo cahen jascayamahi. Jayaxihquibo yohiti ta yamascayaxihquiqui. Huetsa join yohuanti yamascai. Haxeti honan yamascatihi.
Rahma tah non honanquin bi pishinmahi. Yohiquin bi tah non pishinmaribihi.
Noquen Hihbo janin tah non pishinyamascatihi. Honancoinax jahuabi haxeti pishinyamascai. Jaa copi ta non rahma hahquin bi pishinmahi shinanbo yamacahinscayaxihquiqui.

Baquehax tah hen baque quescari yohuannihqui. Baquen hahcai quescarihbijaquin tah hen shinanpahonihqui. Baquen hahcai quescajaquin rihbi yohiquin. Beboscaxon cahen baquebaan hahcai quescapahbo jenebahinscai.

Rahma tah non bahquishjaquin jisquin hahcajaquin honanai. Noquen Hihbo janin sca tah non bejisquin honanquin sirijayaxihqui. Rahma texe res honanxon bi tah hen jaatian sirijaquin honanyaxihqui, jaan hea honanquin hahcai quescajaribiquin.
Jaa copi ta quimisha res banetihqui: Noquen Papa non nincacointi, Papan noque hahxonyaxihquibo honanti, joni huetsahon shinanti. Jaabo quimisha jai bi ta joni huetsahon shinanti hashoan siri qui.
